item.title: ❗ Throughout the day, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continued to carry out group strikes against enterprises of Ukrainian defence industry
item.description: ❗ Throughout the day, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continued to carry out group strikes against enterprises of Ukrainian defence industry and seaports used to support the Armed Forces of Ukraine. 💥 The following targets were hit by strike unmanned aerial vehicles: 📍 in Kiev, an assembly facility of the shipbuilding industry engaged in the assembly and maintenance of remotely controlled boats; 📍 in the port of Nikolayev, a maritime transhipment terminal and four storage facilities containing military equipment intended to support the Armed Forces of Ukraine. 💥 In addition, an electrical substation in Trikhaty of Nikolayev region, which provides power to the port of Nikolayev, was hit . 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
🚩
As a result of active actions, units of the Sever Group of Forces established control over Khrapovshchina (Sumy region).
💥
Manpower and hardware
of a mechanised brigade, two airmobile brigades of the AFU, and a territorial defence brigade have been hit near Sadki, Vakalovshchina, Ulanovo, and Kiyanitsa (Sumy region).
🔥
In Kharkov region
, strikes were delivered at formations of a mechanised brigade, a motorised infantry brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and a territorial defence brigade close to Sosnovy Bor, Berezhnoye, Podsredneye, Tokarevka, and Sliznevo (Kharkov region).
▪️
The AFU lost more than 250 troops, nine motor vehicles, and one field artillery gun.
📍
The Zapad Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
Manpower and hardware of a mechanised brigade, a motorised infantry brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and a territorial defence brigade have been hit near Studenok (Kharkov region), Svyatogorsk, Sidorovo, Tatyanovka, Krymki, and Bogorodichnoye (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy losses amounted to over 220 troops, one U.S.-made HMMWV armoured vehicle, 14 motor vehicles, and two field artillery guns.
📍
The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces improved the tactical situation along the front line
. Formations of two mechanised brigades, an airmobile brigade, a mountain assault brigade, and an assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine have been hit close to Vasilyevskaya Pustosh, Krasny Molochar, Slavyansk, Kramatorsk, Nikolayevka, Druzhkovka, and Vysokoivanovka (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy has lost more than 200 troops, five armoured fighting vehicles, 24 motor vehicles, and two artillery guns.

🎖
🎖
by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation
as of 29 August 2026
Part 2 (
👉
see
Part 1
)
🚩
As a result of resolute actions, units of the Tsentr Group of Forces liberated Rubezhnoye and Novoandreyevka (Donetsk People's Republic).
💥
Manpower and hardware
of a mechanised brigade, an assault brigade of the AFU, a marine brigade, and two national guard brigades have been hit close to Belozerskoye, Veseloye Pole, Svyatogorovka, Zolotoy Kolodez, Sergeyevka, Dobropolye, Novogrigorovka (Donetsk People's Republic), and Novopavlovka (Dnepropetrovsk region).
▪️
Up to 395 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, and seven motor vehicles have been neutralised.
↗️
The Vostok Group of Forces continued advancing into the depth of enemy defence
. Russian troops hit manpower and hardware of a mechanised brigade, an assault brigade, an air assault brigade, two assault regiments of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, a marine brigade, and a territorial defence brigade near Ivanovka, Vasilkovka (Dnepropetrovsk region), Volnyanka, Nikolskoye, Obshcheye, Vasilyevskoye, Rozovka, and Zorevka (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
The enemy lost up to 310 troops and six motor vehicles.
💥
The Dnepr Group of Forces
inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of a mechanised brigade and a UAV brigade of the AFU near Preobrazhenka, Orekhov (Zaporozhye region), and Antonovka (Kherson region).
▪️
Up to 50 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, 13 motor vehicles, and two electronic warfare stations were neutralised.
✈️
Operational-Tactical Aviation, attack drones, missile troops, and artillery of the Russian Russian Groups of Forces
have inflicted damage on the fuel and power infrastructure of Ukraine, logistics centres used by the Armed Forces of Ukraine, assembly workshops, storage areas of unmanned aerial vehicles, and their components as well as temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed formations and foreign mercenaries in 147 areas.
▫️
Air defence systems shot down
five guided aerial bombs, two HIMARS-made MLRS projectiles, eight Flamingo long-range cruise missiles, and 715 fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles.
📊
In total
, since the beginning of the special military operation the enemy has
lost
:

674
aircraft,
▫️
284
helicopters,
▫️
222,352
unmanned aerial vehicles,
▫️
670
anti-aircraft missile systems,
▫️
30,748
tanks and other armoured fighting vehicles,
▫️
1,775
MLRS combat vehicles,
▫️
36,304
field artillery guns and mortars,
▫️
70,490
units of support military vehicles.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ❗️ Last evening and during the night of 29 August, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation
item.description: ❗️ Last evening and during the night of 29 August, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continued to launch group strikes against logistics centres and seaports of Ukraine involved in the interests of the Armed Forces of Ukraine. 💥 Unmanned aerial vehicles and high-precision air-launched weapons hit : 📍 in Kiev and Kiev region: ▪️ the Fim Service transport and logistics centre in Chayki. Its warehouses were used to store Flamingo long-range cruise missiles; ▪️ a logistics centre in Kalinovka. There, a customs terminal is located. It distributes military cargo from western countries; ▪️ an ammunition depot in Milaya (Fire Point LLC), where components and launch boosters for long-range FP-1/FP-2 unmanned aerial vehicles were stored in warehouses. 💥 In addition, the following were engaged : ▪️ in the port of Izmail, a parking area of fuel refuellers and offloading site of POLs intended for the AFU; ▪️ in the port of Nikolayev, a sea cargo terminal, logistics centres used for unloading and storing military cargo, 18 depots with military equipment, and three POL depots to support the Armed Forces of Ukraine. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
